title: Analytics, Decision Intelligence & Business Briefing
objective: Build one governed Worker→Specialist→Manager→Orchestrator analytical workforce that converts authoritative operational state into metric truth, insights, forecasts, decision briefs and cross-domain synthesis without granting analytics operational authority.

subgoals.title: Define the canonical Analytics, Decision Intelligence & Business Briefing workforce, semantic/evidence boundaries and non-duplication map across operational domains and Titan Prime
subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count

recommendations: Recommend clearly bounded decision options and trade-offs to authorised humans/Titan Prime, with no implied right to execute them.
Recommend investigation or attention priority with evidence, confidence and plausible competing explanations; do not assert unsupported causality.
Recommend the analytical priorities and decision questions with the highest supported business relevance, clearly separating evidence, inference and recommendation.
Recommend the canonical metric definition, scope and caveats supported by current authoritative evidence.
Recommend the small set of decisions/questions that deserve attention, with evidence, confidence, alternatives and explicit unresolved uncertainty.
Recommend which scenarios/trade-offs deserve attention based on evidence and sensitivity, while keeping forecast and decision separate.
agent_binding_notes: Canonical definitions appear exactly once here. Analytical engines/models/dashboards are tools, not workforce identities.
Decision Intelligence is advisory/analytical: operational authority remains with domain Managers; strategic orchestration remains with authorised humans/Titan Prime.

goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Decision Intelligence owns governed metric meaning/provenance, analytical detection/interpretation, uncertainty-aware forecasts/scenarios, recurring business briefs and decision/outcome tracking.

Operational domain Managers retain authority and accountability for Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Service Delivery, Supply, Field and other business outcomes; analytical agents do not mutate those domains solely because an insight exists.
Decision Intelligence Synthesis Orchestrator prepares cross-domain evidence/trade-offs for authorised humans and Titan Prime; Titan Prime remains strategic orchestrator and is not duplicated here.
Signal Engine, Wisdom Engine, Foresight Engine, Rewind, dashboards, BI stores and models are engines/tools/evidence systems, not separate workforce identities.
Every analytical output must separate observed facts, derived metrics, interpretations, forecasts/scenarios and recommendations, with source/version/freshness/uncertainty evidence.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
